assumptions.reason: The specification requires an adjustable SMA(volume,20) liquidity threshold but does not state its default value.

assumptions.choice: enforce_pdt_rule defaults to False; when enabled it requires broker account value to be greater than $25,000 before entries.
assumptions.reason: The specification describes the PDT balance condition as optional.

assumptions.choice: Main session is interpreted as timestamps from 09:30 through 15:59 local feed time, with the first three minutes skipped so entries begin at 09:33.
assumptions.reason: The OHLCV feed supplies timestamps but no exchange-session metadata.

assumptions.choice: A timeout exit is submitted after three completed bars following the entry fill.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define whether the fill bar itself counts as one of the three bars.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit and stop-loss are submitted as OCO limit and stop orders after the entry fill, using the actual executed entry price.
assumptions.reason: This is the closest literal implementation of exits at stated price offsets in Backtrader.
